bugs.text: Every enemy is created with hp:1, so Boss Galaga dies in one hit, is always drawn in the purple 'damaged' colour, the Boss-hit sound never plays and a formation Boss scores 300 instead of 150.
Enemy bullet on the dual fighter passes e=null, which clears both halves and kills the whole ship instead of one half.
startStage resets p.dual=false, so the dual fighter is lost at every new stage.

Capture takes 0.7 s and respawn 1.5 s while the beam lasts 2.5 s with full-width capture from its first frame; a respawned ship at x=112 within 35 px of the Boss is captured again, losing a second ship.
The captured fighter never fires; the only 'captive fire' code runs in the tractor state of the capturing Boss and shoots from the Boss position.

Challenging Stage waves overlap (next wave after 5 s, a wave takes ~8 s), so per-wave kill counts are reset early and the 1,000 wave bonus is almost never awarded; results can appear while wave-5 enemies are frozen on screen.
After a Challenging Stage the next stage starts with no STAGE N screen or jingle.
If the last surviving enemy is shot before all enemies reached formation, formationDone is never set and the stage never advances (soft-lock, unlikely in practice).
Stage badge is a single flag cycling 1,5,10,20,30,50 by stage index, not a sum of denominations.
All 40 entering enemies fire aimed shots during entry; in the play-test the bot lost all three ships within about 10 s of stage 1 (screenshots 2, 3 and 4-play-015s), making early play very harsh.
Reserve-ship HUD counts the ship in play when the player is not alive, so the title screen and respawn show one ship too many.

summary: A compact, cleanly organised single file with a proper fixed-timestep loop, separated state/update/render, Bezier entry and dive paths, a convincing widening tractor beam, working capture, rescue-to-dual-fighter and captive-lost logic, and a correct results screen; it loads clean and the play-test reached scoring play and the game-over/title cycle. Faithfulness suffers from several rule bugs: Bosses are one-hit and always purple because every enemy starts with hp 1, a bullet kills both halves of the dual fighter and the dual is reset each stage, the captured fighter never fires, the Challenging Stage is a straight sine sweep whose overlapping waves break the per-wave bonus, badges cycle instead of summing, and two of the required sounds (enemy hit, Boss hit) never play. Sprites are simple blobs with the Goei and Boss sharing a shape, and entry fire is heavy enough that the bot lost all ships in about 10 seconds. It plays as a recognisable Galaga, with noticeable flaws.
